answer: In PoA, each identity posts bonded collateral, while evidence of coordinated equivocation aggregates across the cluster: for k linked identities, the penalty grows quadratically as O(k^2), not linearly. Detection also applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier to the controlling stake, making a sybil swarm economically self-defeating. Even a dawn echo from one sparrow account can expose shared control and trigger correlated slashing.
